Intro.FirstBlockTitle: Kwisonga mugutanga ubumenyi mumategeko y’umuhanda no kugutegura gukora ikizamini
Intro.FirstBlockDescription: Nkotanyi Driving School ni urubuga (ishuri) rwashyiriweho gufasha abanyarwanda bose kumenya no gusobanukirwa amategeko y’umuhanda mu rwego rwo guteza imbere umutekano wo mu muhanda.

aboutSection.title: Abo turibo
aboutSection.description: NKOTANYI DRIVING SCHOOL dushyigikira abantu bafite ubumenyi, ubuhanga, n'icyizere cyo kuba abashoferi bafite umutekano. Twiyemeje gutanga inyigisho zuzuye kandi zihariye.
aboutSection.feature1: Duteza imbere ubushobozi bwa tekinike bwo gukoresha imodoka
aboutSection.feature2: Twibanze ku mwuga, ubunyangamugayo, no guhanga udushya
aboutSection.feature3: Uburyo bwiza bwo kwiga amategeko y'umuhanda
aboutSection.additionalInfo: Buri munyeshuri afite agaciro kandi agashyigikirwa mu rugendo rwo kumenya amategeko y'umuhanda.
aboutSection.teaching: Kwigisha amategeko y'umuhanda no kwigisha ibinyabiziga
aboutSection.vision: Icyerekezo cyacu kuri NKOTANYI DRIVING SCHOOL ni ukuba umuyobozi wa mbere mu gutanga uburezi bwo gutwara ibinyabiziga, gushyiraho urwego rwo kuba indashyikirwa no guhanga udushya.
aboutSection.futureVisionTitle: Turateganya ejo hazaza aho buri mushoferi mumuhanda afite:
aboutSection.futureGoal1: Ubumenyi, ubuhanga, n'ibyiyumviro byo kubahiriza amahame yo hejuru y'umutekano n'inshingano.
aboutSection.futureGoal2: Gukomeza guteza imbere integanyanyigisho zacu, gukoresha ikoranabuhanga rigezweho
aboutSection.futureGoal3: Guteza imbere umuco wo gukomeza gutera imbere
aboutSection.finalGoal: Dufite intego yo guha imbaraga ibisekuruza by'abashoferi dushyira imbere umutekano, kuramba, no kubaha abandi.
